integrity: The packaged Python checker is self-contained and performs exact integer Gram and Cauchy--Binet minor computations, complete orbit and rigidity checks. It does not assert external or independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite spectrum only for vertex-supported tetrahedra of the regular 24-cell. The unrestricted global maximum and equality classification are proved separately using wedge convexity and no-shared-triple rigidity. Historical priority is provisional; the exact table depends on exhaustive integer verification rather than a symbolic orbit-by-orbit hand calculation. Independent audit not performed.
title: Complete tetrahedral volume spectrum and rigid maximal disphenoids of the regular 24-cell
